ratings_why.fun: Borrowing the best text in the lobby is a treat to draft, but every Changeling carries two texts and the Lady five, so the growing board is hard to read at a glance.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because Exchange trades your units with the shop and Turncoat Hare and Penny Second wear the enemy's text; no tribe today touches the shop or the enemy board, and both play the swap folklore straight.

verdict_why: Three timing rules are unclear as written (Cradle Kit's borrowed When played, stolen Start of Combat text, Exchange's 'a token is removed'); fixing them is wording, not redesign.

points.text: Cradle Kit takes its Guise when played; the Guise rule only says a Guise worn when played fires. Say plainly whether the borrowed When played fires on that same play.
Turncoat Hare and Penny Second take a Guise at Start of Combat; say whether a stolen Start of Combat text fires that fight. The Impostors build and the Keeper assume it does.
Exchange ends with 'and a token is removed', which no card explains. Name the token or cut the clause.
